title: Count Numbers With Property
prompt:
**Tình huống.** Given N ≤ 10^18, count the integers in [1, N] whose decimal digits are non-decreasing (e.g. 1259 yes, 129 no).

**Thuật toán nào phù hợp nhất? Chương trình chỉ cần in ra chữ cái.**

**A)** Sieve up to N (impossible memory)

**B)** Iterate and check each number up to N

**C)** Digit DP over the decimal representation of N

**D)** Two pointers over digits

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: N has up to 19 digits; the count itself is over digit *positions* — the classic digit DP shape: state = position + last digit + tight flag.
